title: Arakan Army Captures Three Outposts as Junta's Laymyethna Recapture Offensive Grinds On
detail: The Arakan Army and allied resistance forces captured three Myanmar military outposts in Laymyethna Township, Ayeyarwady Region, in counter-attacks against the junta's ground offensive to recapture AA-held territory, reported September 26, 2026. Light Infantry Division 66, the Southwestern Command, and allied Pyu Saw Htee militias have conducted operations across Pandawgyi, Setsetyo and Yonsel villages in Laymyethna, with clashes also spreading to neighboring Yekyi and Thabaung townships since early September as part of the broader 'Operation 4926' campaign; regime forces have so far failed to make significant advances.

title: Arakan Army Claims Four Outposts Near Sittwe, Advances Within 2 Miles of Regional Operations Command
detail: Local reports on September 26, 2026 said Arakan Army fighters captured at least four junta military outposts in Sittwe Township along the Sittwe-Ponnagyun border, advancing to within roughly two miles of the junta's Regional Operations Command headquarters in Sittwe. Fighting was reported around Yae Yo Pyin and War Bo villages, the Taw Kan area, near Shwe Min Gan and toward Pauktaw (Weera Thani), with the junta responding with at least four aircraft — jet fighters and Y-12 transport planes flying bombing and reconnaissance runs — plus reconnaissance drones and naval artillery. The advance follows the junta's September 21 offensive, which stalled after heavy regime casualties; AA claims remain unverified by independent sources.
